# All documented --root placements select the board directory, not the cwd.
mkdir 'board one' 'board two' 'board three' 'board four'

exec weft$exe --root 'board one' init --json
json
stdout '"initialized": true'
exec weft$exe add 'First selected board' --root 'board one'
exists 'board one/WEFT.md' 'board one/tasks/backlog/001-first-selected-board.md'

exec weft$exe init --root 'board two' --json
json
stdout '"projection_updated": true'
exec weft$exe add 'Second selected board' --root='board two'
exists 'board two/tasks/backlog/001-second-selected-board.md'

exec weft$exe --root=board-three init --json
json
exec weft$exe add 'Third selected board' --root=board-three
exists board-three/tasks/backlog/001-third-selected-board.md

exec weft$exe init --root=board-four --json
json
exec weft$exe add 'Fourth selected board' --root=board-four
exists board-four/tasks/backlog/001-fourth-selected-board.md

! exists tasks WEFT.md
